capabilities: define short, full, and long title aliases in a note's YAML properties
display internal links as short, full, or combined titles via the alias section
render customized link titles in both read mode and edit mode
extras: The roadmap shows base functionality done for read and edit modes, while settings customization, hover tooltips, and other display-mode selection methods are still unfinished.
problem: Obsidian internal links show only one fixed title, with no built-in way to switch between an acronym, abbreviation, or full title display.
summary: Plugin that lets notes define short, full, and combined title aliases in YAML so internal links can display each format.
